findings.description: compareEntries now returns (b.score - a.score) + (a.penalties - b.penalties), combining two incomparable keys into a single number; when the penalty difference is large enough it can outweigh a small score difference on an entirely different scale, so a lower-scoring player can rank above a higher-scoring one and the documented penalties tie-break silently breaks.
